text: A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:15. It stops twice on the way, for 12 minutes each time. For how many minutes was it moving? Show your working, then give the answer on its own line.
Write a Python function `is_palindrome(s: str) -> bool` that ignores case and every character that is not a letter or a digit. Follow it with three assert statements that test it.
What does a company's EBITDA margin measure, and why might an analyst prefer it to net profit margin when comparing two companies? Answer in one paragraph.
Explain in three sentences why a language model that generates text one token at a time benefits from caching the keys and values of the tokens before it.

Extract the company, the quarter and the revenue from the sentence below as JSON with the keys "company", "quarter" and "revenue_crore". Output nothing but the JSON.

Sentence: Northwind Textiles reported revenue of ₹1,284 crore for the second quarter of fiscal 2025, up 7.2% from a year earlier.
Why is Canberra, and not Sydney, the capital of Australia? Answer in two or three sentences.
List exactly three renewable sources of electricity as a numbered list, one per line, with no other text before or after the list.
Asha is taller than Ben. Ben is taller than Chitra. Dev is shorter than Chitra. Who is the second shortest of the four? Explain briefly.

Summarise the following passage in one sentence.

It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief, it was the epoch of incredulity, it was the season of Light, it was the season of Darkness, it was the spring of hope, it was the winter of despair, we had everything before us, we had nothing before us, we were all going direct to Heaven, we were all going direct the other way—in short, the period was so far like the present period, that some of its noisiest authorities insisted on its being received, for good or for evil, in the superlative degree of comparison only.
